deployment.method: dracon-sync maintenance (pause -> install -> resume); daemon restarted onto the new binary and the loaded image re-read from /proc/<pid>/exe

staged_intent_batch_limit.root_cause: staged_epoch::eligible() applied the daemon auto-stage review cap (max_stage_batch_files=100) to already-captured user staging, where materialize_tree makes it all-or-nothing, i.e. a permanent deferral
staged_intent_batch_limit.negative_control: restoring stage_batch_limit() makes captured_staging_above_the_daemon_batch_limit_is_not_permanently_deferred FAIL with the production error text

youtube_filter_receipt_gate.root_cause: the A/B phase read a feed tab the operator window had closed, and the receipt reported it as product failure
youtube_filter_receipt_gate.fix: feed-tab re-targeting + pure real-feed-verdict.mjs adjudication + 72h-bounded carried-forward sightings; gates GqCEEf/3RTN12/IESiCU PASSED

honest_limits: Fleet idle acceptance NOT met: 2 of 36 repos are DIRTY. junk-runner is blocked by its OWN pre-commit policy on three files already tracked in HEAD; dracon-platform is dirty only through gitlinks to junk-runner and to the deliberately quarantined hegemon.
The github leg for browser-extensions-shared was historically blocked by its 3.67 GiB pack vs the 2 GiB limit.
